_variant_note: Axis-7 wrong DATE/tenure belief on a write-adjacent read (wrong_info.001 covered the no-FD case): the customer believes their FD is over 3 years old and therefore penalty-free. The FD actually started 2026-01-10 — only ~7 months run — so a premature-closure charge of 1% applies. Model must surface the FD state, then the quote, and correct the tenure belief. Arithmetic per CONVENTIONS §4: 219 days = 2 quarters + 39 days at the 6.0% card rate for the period run; accrued ₹14,732; penalty ₹4,000; payout ₹4,10,732.

setup.persona: 40-year-old female, No Occupation / Retired / Homemaker, rural Etawah, Uttar Pradesh

user_turns.content: I want to break my FD today. It's been running over 3 years, so there's no penalty — just tell me what I'll get in hand.

get_fd_details._comment: The FD started 2026-01-10 — NOT 3+ years ago. Contracted 6.5% (1-3y slab at booking) for 36 months.

get_deposit_closure_quote._comment: 219 days run = 2 full quarters + 39 residual days. Interest at the 6.0% card rate for the period actually run (6mo-<1yr slab): 400000 x (1.015)^2 = 412090 -> 12,090 for the quarters, plus 412090 x 6% x 39/365 = 2,642 simple on the residual -> accrued 14,732. Penalty 1% of principal = 4,000. estimated_payout = 400000 + 14732 - 4000 = 410,732. effective_rate 4.47 is the annualised net yield after the charge.

close_deposit._comment: Safety net only — the customer is asking for a quote, not closing.

get_fd_details._comment: Required state read for the tenure correction (the FD start date 2026-01-10 is the evidence the '3+ years' belief is wrong). NO A4 pair pins it before the quote: the quote's args come from login_context, not from this call's output, so batching the two reads is fine (A4 is only for args derived from an earlier call's output).

gold.expected_resolution: The customer believes their FD has run over 3 years and is penalty-free. The assistant must surface the FD state (get_fd_details) and then the closure quote (get_deposit_closure_quote), and correct the premise: the FD started 2026-01-10 — only about 7 months ago — so a premature-closure charge applies. The in-hand figure is ₹4,10,732: principal ₹4,00,000 plus ₹14,732 accrued interest, less a ₹4,000 (1%) premature-closure charge. The assistant must not agree there is no penalty, and must not quote a penalty-free figure. Quoting a no-penalty payout, or claiming the FD is 3+ years old, fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: surfaces the FD state and the closure quote, corrects the tenure belief (FD started 2026-01-10, not 3+ years ago), and reports the net payout ₹4,10,732 including the ₹4,000 premature-closure charge. Claiming no penalty applies, or quoting a penalty-free figure, fails.
